tool_schemas.name: figma_get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current Figma user profile for the given local account and, when `hydrate` is true, upserts the user into the local `figma_accounts` catalog; when `use_cache` is true, it may return a recently cached snapshot instead of calling Figma. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `account_id` is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED when the stored token for `account_id` is missing/expired/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the token lacks access, and NOT_FOUND when the local `account_id` does not exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when the upstream or local quota is exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

hydrate.description: If true, upsert the fetched user into the local figma_accounts catalog.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a recently cached snapshot when available.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_file
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a Figma file by `file_key` (optionally for a specific `version`) and can limit the returned document via `ids`/`depth` and include `plugin_data`/`branch_data`; when `hydrate` is true it upserts/refreshes related local `figma_resources`, and when `snapshot` is true it persists the response in `figma_snapshots` (with `use_cache` allowing a fresh cached snapshot to be returned). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid parameters (including negative `depth`), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the `account_id` credentials are missing/invalid or lack access to the file, and NOT_FOUND when the file key (or specified version) does not exist or is not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

version.description: Specific file version id to fetch.

ids.description: Optional list of node ids to include (limits returned document tree).

depth.description: Optional traversal depth when returning document children.

plugin_data.description: Optional plugin id to include plugin data for.

branch_data.description: If true, include branch metadata in the response when supported.

hydrate.description: If true, upsert/refresh local figma_resources for the file and its related entities.

snapshot.description: If true, persist the response payload to figma_snapshots for caching/auditing.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a fresh cached snapshot when available.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_file_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Returns the specified node(s) from a Figma file for the given `ids` (optionally at a specific `version`) and may include children up to `depth`, optional `plugin_data`, and `geometry`; when `snapshot` is true it stores the payload in `figma_snapshots` and `use_cache` may return a fresh cached snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `ids` is empty, `depth` is invalid, or `geometry` is not supported, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the account token is missing/invalid or lacks file access, and NOT_FOUND when the file, version, or requested node ids cannot be found/are not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when upstream or local quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

ids.description: Node ids to fetch from the file.

version.description: Specific file version id to fetch nodes from.

depth.description: Optional traversal depth when returning node children.

plugin_data.description: Optional plugin id to include plugin data for.

geometry.description: Controls inclusion of vector geometry data where supported.

snapshot.description: If true, persist the response payload to figma_snapshots for caching/auditing.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a fresh cached snapshot when available.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_images
tool_schemas.description: Requests rendered image URLs for the given node `ids` in a file, in the requested `format` (optionally with `scale`, bounds and SVG options, and a specific `version`); when `snapshot` is true it stores the result in `figma_snapshots` and `use_cache` may return a fresh cached snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid parameters (including empty `ids`, invalid `format`, or `scale` < 0.01), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the account token is missing/invalid or lacks file access, and NOT_FOUND when the file/version/node ids do not exist or are not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when rendering or API quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

ids.description: Node ids to render as images.

use_absolute_bounds.description: If true, render using absolute bounds.

version.description: Specific file version id to render from.

svg_include_id.description: If true, include node id attributes in SVG output.

svg_simplify_stroke.description: If true, simplify stroke rendering in SVG output.

contents_only.description: If true, omit the frame/outer container when rendering where supported.

snapshot.description: If true, persist the response payload to figma_snapshots for caching/auditing.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a fresh cached snapshot when available.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_image_fills
tool_schemas.description: Returns the image-fill metadata for a Figma file (as provided by Figma) and, when `snapshot` is true, persists the payload to `figma_snapshots` with `use_cache` allowing a fresh cached snapshot to be returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required parameters are missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the account token is missing/invalid or lacks access, and NOT_FOUND when the file key does not exist or is not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when upstream or local quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

snapshot.description: If true, persist the response payload to figma_snapshots for caching/auditing.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a fresh cached snapshot when available.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_file_versions
tool_schemas.description: Returns the version history for a file, limited by `page_size`, and paged using provider cursors (`before`/`after`) as supplied/returned by Figma; when `snapshot` is true it stores the payload in `figma_snapshots` and `use_cache` may return a fresh cached snapshot. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `page_size` is out of range or cursors are malformed, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the account token is missing/invalid or lacks access, and NOT_FOUND when the file key does not exist or is not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when upstream or local quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

page_size.description: Maximum number of versions to return.

before.description: Pagination cursor to fetch versions before a specific version id/timestamp (provider-specific).

after.description: Pagination cursor to fetch versions after a specific version id/timestamp (provider-specific).

snapshot.description: If true, persist the response payload to figma_snapshots for caching/auditing.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a fresh cached snapshot when available.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments for a file (optionally as of `as_of`) and returns a single page of results up to `page_size`, using `cursor` for pagination as provided by Figma; when `hydrate` is true it upserts the comments into the local `figma_comments` catalog, and when `snapshot` is true it stores the payload in `figma_snapshots` with `use_cache` allowing a fresh cached snapshot to be returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid timestamps, `page_size` out of range, or malformed `cursor`, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the account token is missing/invalid or lacks access, and NOT_FOUND when the file does not exist or is not accessible. Raises RATE_LIMITED when upstream or local quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

as_of.description: If provided, return comments as of this timestamp where supported.

page_size.description: Maximum number of comments to return per page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

hydrate.description: If true, upsert fetched comments into the local figma_comments catalog.

snapshot.description: If true, persist the response payload to figma_snapshots for caching/auditing.

use_cache.description: If true, allow returning a fresh cached snapshot when available.

tool_schemas.name: figma_post_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment on a file (or a reply when `parent_figma_comment_id` is provided) using the supplied `message` and optional `client_meta`, and records the intent/outcome under `idempotency_key` to dedupe retries and support auditing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `message` is empty, required fields are missing, or `client_meta` is invalid for the requested comment type, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the account token is missing/invalid or lacks permission to comment, and NOT_FOUND when the file or `parent_figma_comment_id` does not exist or is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT when the same `idempotency_key` is reused with different payload fields, and RATE_LIMITED when comment-creation limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

client_meta.description: Figma client_meta payload describing where the comment is pinned (coordinates/node reference).

parent_figma_comment_id.description: If provided, post this as a reply to an existing Figma comment id.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key to dedupe retries and persist intent/outcome.

tool_schemas.name: figma_delete_comment
tool_schemas.description: Delete a comment from a Figma file

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

file_key.description: Figma file key containing the comment.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to safely retry the deletion.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_comment_reactions
tool_schemas.description: Get reactions for a comment

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

file_key.description: Figma file key containing the comment.

comment_id.description: Figma comment ID whose reactions should be fetched.

limit.description: Maximum number of reactions to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

hydrate.description: When true, upserts fetched reactions into the local cache.

tool_schemas.name: figma_post_comment_reaction
tool_schemas.description: Adds an emoji reaction to the specified Figma comment using the linked account and returns the created reaction along with our persisted operation record (including status/outcome) so retries can be audited and resumed. If idempotency_key is provided, repeated calls with the same key return the same recorded result instead of creating duplicates; otherwise a new create attempt is recorded each time. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty or account_id format is invalid; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account lacks access to the file/comment; NOT_FOUND if file_key or comment_id does not exist/resolve; CONFLICT if an identical reaction already exists for that user/comment or the idempotency_key is reused with different parameters; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

file_key.description: Figma file key containing the comment.

comment_id.description: Figma comment ID to react to.

emoji.description: Emoji to add as a reaction (unicode emoji string).

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to safely retry creating the reaction.

tool_schemas.name: figma_delete_comment_reaction
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a reaction from the specified Figma comment using the linked account and returns a deletion result plus our persisted operation record (including status/outcome) to support retries and auditability. If idempotency_key is provided, repeated calls with the same key return the same recorded outcome, including when the reaction was already deleted. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty fields or invalid account_id format; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account lacks access to the file/comment or cannot delete that reaction; NOT_FOUND if file_key, comment_id, or reaction_id does not exist/resolve; CONFLICT if the idempotency_key is reused with different parameters; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

file_key.description: Figma file key containing the comment.

comment_id.description: Figma comment ID containing the reaction.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key to safely retry deleting the reaction.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_team_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects in the given Figma team for the linked account and returns a page of projects plus a next cursor when more results are available; limit controls page size (default server-chosen) and cursor continues from a prior response. When hydrate=true, we upsert the returned projects into the local catalog and return the same page of results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id format, missing team_id, or out-of-range limit/cursor; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the team; NOT_FOUND if the team_id does not exist/resolve; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

team_id.description: Figma team ID to list projects for.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

hydrate.description: When true, upserts fetched projects into the local catalog.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_project_files
tool_schemas.description: Lists files in the given Figma project for the linked account and returns a page of files plus a next cursor when more results are available; limit controls page size (default server-chosen) and cursor continues from a prior response. When hydrate=true, we upsert the returned files into the local catalog and return the same page of results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id format, missing project_id, or out-of-range limit/cursor; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the project; NOT_FOUND if the project_id does not exist/resolve; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

project_id.description: Figma project ID to list files for.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

hydrate.description: When true, upserts fetched files into the local catalog.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_team_components
tool_schemas.description: Lists components available in the given Figma team for the linked account and returns a page of components plus a next cursor when more results are available; limit controls page size (default server-chosen) and cursor continues from a prior response. When hydrate=true, we upsert the returned components into the local catalog and return the same page of results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id format, missing team_id, or out-of-range limit/cursor; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the team; NOT_FOUND if the team_id does not exist/resolve; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

team_id.description: Figma team ID to list components for.

limit.description: Maximum number of components to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

hydrate.description: When true, upserts fetched components into the local catalog.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_file_components
tool_schemas.description: Lists components in the given Figma file for the linked account and returns a page of components plus a next cursor when more results are available; limit controls page size (default server-chosen) and cursor continues from a prior response. When hydrate=true, we upsert the returned components into the local catalog and return the same page of results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id format, missing file_key, or out-of-range limit/cursor; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the file; NOT_FOUND if the file_key does not exist/resolve; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

file_key.description: Figma file key to list components for.

limit.description: Maximum number of components to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

hydrate.description: When true, upserts fetched components into the local catalog.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_component
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single component by its Figma key using the linked account and returns the component payload; when use_cache=true we may return a cached snapshot, and when refresh=true we force a fetch from Figma and update any cached snapshot. If both use_cache and refresh are provided, refresh takes precedence for the returned value. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id format or missing/empty key; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the component’s containing file/team; NOT_FOUND if the component key does not exist/resolve; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached snapshot if available.

refresh.description: Whether to force-fetch from Figma and refresh any cached snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_team_component_sets
tool_schemas.description: Lists component sets in the given Figma team for the linked account and returns a page of component sets plus a next cursor when more results are available; page_size controls the number of results per page and cursor continues from a prior response. When use_cache=true we may serve a cached snapshot, and when refresh=true we force a fetch from Figma and update any cached snapshot (refresh takes precedence). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id format, missing team_id, invalid page_size, or malformed cursor; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the team; NOT_FOUND if the team_id does not exist/resolve; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

page_size.description: Number of results to return per page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached snapshot if available.

refresh.description: Whether to force-fetch from Figma and refresh any cached snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_file_component_sets
tool_schemas.description: Lists component sets in the given Figma file for the linked account and returns a page of component sets plus a next cursor when more results are available; page_size controls the number of results per page and cursor continues from a prior response. When use_cache=true we may serve a cached snapshot, and when refresh=true we force a fetch from Figma and update any cached snapshot (refresh takes precedence). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id format, missing file_key, invalid page_size, or malformed cursor; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the file; NOT_FOUND if the file_key does not exist/resolve; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

page_size.description: Number of results to return per page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached snapshot if available.

refresh.description: Whether to force-fetch from Figma and refresh any cached snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_component_set
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single component set by its Figma key using the linked account and returns the component set payload; when use_cache=true we may return a cached snapshot, and when refresh=true we force a fetch from Figma and update any cached snapshot. If both use_cache and refresh are provided, refresh takes precedence for the returned value. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id format or missing/empty key; UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/disabled or its token is invalid/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the component set’s containing file/team; NOT_FOUND if the component set key does not exist/resolve; RATE_LIMITED if Figma or this service throttles the request.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached snapshot if available.

refresh.description: Whether to force-fetch from Figma and refresh any cached snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_team_styles
tool_schemas.description: Lists styles available to a Figma team using the linked account and returns a page of style summaries plus a cursor for the next page when more results exist (page size is controlled by page_size; omit cursor for the first page). If use_cache is true we may return a cached snapshot; if refresh is true we fetch from Figma and refresh the cached snapshot before returning results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id/team_id, page_size out of range, or an unknown cursor; UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not linked or tokens are missing/expired; FORBIDDEN if the account lacks access to the team; NOT_FOUND if the team does not exist or is not visible to the account; RATE_LIMITED when Figma or this service throttles requests.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

page_size.description: Number of results to return per page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached snapshot if available.

refresh.description: Whether to force-fetch from Figma and refresh any cached snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_file_styles
tool_schemas.description: Lists styles defined in a specific Figma file and returns a page of style summaries plus a next-page cursor when applicable (page_size controls page length; pass cursor from the prior response to continue). If use_cache is true we may serve a cached snapshot; if refresh is true we force-fetch from Figma and update the cached snapshot before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id/file_key, page_size out of range, or an invalid cursor; UNAUTHORIZED if the account linkage is missing or authentication is invalid; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the file; NOT_FOUND if the file key does not exist; RATE_LIMITED when upstream or service quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

page_size.description: Number of results to return per page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached snapshot if available.

refresh.description: Whether to force-fetch from Figma and refresh any cached snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_style
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single style by Figma style key and returns the style details, optionally hydrating/updating a cached snapshot based on use_cache/refresh. If use_cache is true we may return a cached copy; if refresh is true we fetch from Figma and update the cached snapshot before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id or style key; UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not linked or credentials are invalid; FORBIDDEN if the account lacks permission to view the style’s library/file; NOT_FOUND if the style key does not exist; RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached snapshot if available.

refresh.description: Whether to force-fetch from Figma and refresh any cached snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: figma_post_webhook
tool_schemas.description: Creates a webhook under the specified Figma team and returns the local webhook record including lifecycle/status and, when creation succeeds, the remote Figma webhook identifier. If idempotency_key is provided we deduplicate retries and return the existing created record for the same key instead of creating a duplicate; we persist intent and sync outcome for auditing and retries. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid fields (including non-URI endpoint_url) or invalid account_id; UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not linked or tokens are invalid; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot manage webhooks for the team; NOT_FOUND if the team does not exist or is not accessible; CONFLICT if idempotency_key refers to a request with different payload or if a webhook with the same team/event_type/endpoint_url cannot be created due to upstream constraints; RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

team_id.description: Figma team ID to create the webhook under.

event_type.description: Figma webhook event type to subscribe to.

endpoint_url.description: Publicly reachable URL that will receive webhook events.

passcode.description: Webhook passcode used to sign/verify webhook payloads (stored encrypted).

active.description: Whether the webhook should be active upon creation.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided idempotency key used to deduplicate creates/retries.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_webhook
tool_schemas.description: Returns the local webhook record by webhook_id and, when include_remote is true, attempts to fetch the current remote state from Figma and hydrate/cache the local record. The response includes the webhook configuration fields plus lifecycle/status and any last sync/error metadata we have recorded. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed account_id/webhook_id; UNAUTHORIZED if the account linkage is missing or credentials are invalid; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access the associated team/webhook; NOT_FOUND if the local webhook record does not exist, or (when include_remote is true) the remote webhook is missing; RATE_LIMITED when request limits are exceeded.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

webhook_id.description: Local webhook record ID to fetch (maps to a Figma webhook when synced).

include_remote.description: When true, fetch the webhook from Figma and hydrate/cache the local record when possible.

tool_schemas.name: figma_update_webhook
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified webhook with any provided fields and returns the updated local record with lifecycle/status reflecting whether a remote sync is pending or completed. If idempotency_key is provided we deduplicate retries of the same update and return the existing outcome for that key. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id/webhook_id, invalid field values (including endpoint_url), or an empty body with no updatable fields; UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not linked or tokens are invalid; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot manage the webhook; NOT_FOUND if the webhook record does not exist (or its remote counterpart cannot be found when syncing); CONFLICT if idempotency_key is reused with a different payload or if the webhook is in a terminal state (deleted) that refuses updates; RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

webhook_id.description: Local webhook record ID to update.

event_type.description: Figma webhook event type to subscribe to.

endpoint_url.description: HTTPS endpoint that will receive webhook deliveries.

passcode.description: Webhook passcode/secret used to verify deliveries (stored encrypted).

active.description: Whether the webhook should be active.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying this update without duplicating side effects.

body.description: Webhook fields to update; provided fields will be applied and propagated to Figma with lifecycle tracking.

tool_schemas.name: figma_delete_webhook
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified webhook and returns the resulting local record/state, marking it pending_delete and then deleted when remote deletion succeeds, while keeping audit history for retries. If idempotency_key is provided we deduplicate retries and return the previously recorded deletion outcome rather than issuing a second deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id/webhook_id; UNAUTHORIZED if the account linkage is missing or credentials are invalid; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot manage the webhook; NOT_FOUND if the webhook record does not exist (or, when syncing, the remote webhook is already gone); CONFLICT if the webhook is already deleted/pending_delete and the request would violate lifecycle rules or if idempotency_key is reused with a different intent; RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

webhook_id.description: Local webhook record ID to delete (and delete remotely when synced).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying this delete without duplicating side effects.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_team_webhooks
tool_schemas.description: Lists webhook records for the given team resource and returns up to limit results ordered by sort, along with a cursor when additional pages are available (omit cursor for the first page and pass the returned cursor to continue). When include_remote is true we also list webhooks from Figma for the mapped team and hydrate/cache corresponding local records where possible before returning the page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed inputs, invalid cursor, limit out of range, or invalid filter values; UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not linked or credentials are invalid; FORBIDDEN if the account cannot access/manage the team; NOT_FOUND if team_resource_id does not map to a known team; RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Figma account to use for authentication.

team_resource_id.description: Local resource ID for the team whose webhooks should be listed.

include_remote.description: When true, list webhooks from Figma and hydrate/cache local webhook records.

active.description: Filter by whether the webhook is active.

limit.description: Maximum number of webhooks to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_library_analytics_component_usages
tool_schemas.description: Fetches library analytics component usage for the specified resource scope and returns the analytics payload along with snapshot metadata when available. If use_cache is true we return a non-expired cached snapshot when present; if force_refresh is true we bypass cache, fetch fresh analytics from Figma, and persist a new snapshot before returning. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid account_id/resource_id or conflicting cache flags; UNAUTHORIZED if the account linkage is missing or credentials are invalid; FORBIDDEN if the account lacks access to the scoped library/team/file; NOT_FOUND if resource_id does not map to a supported analytics scope; RATE_LIMITED when upstream or service limits are exceeded.

use_cache.description: When true, serve from a non-expired cached snapshot if available; otherwise fetch from Figma and persist a new snapshot.

force_refresh.description: When true, bypass cache and fetch fresh analytics from Figma, persisting the snapshot.

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/resource_id are malformed or unknown parameters are provided, UNAUTHORIZED if the linked account is missing/invalid or cannot authenticate to Figma, FORBIDDEN if the account lacks access to the library scope, and NOT_FOUND if the local resource_id does not resolve or the upstream library scope does not exist. resource_id.description: Local resource ID for the library scope (typically a team or file) to fetch analytics for.

tool_schemas.name: figma_list_resources
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally cataloged `figma_resources` for an account, with optional filtering by type/status/parent and basic text search. Returns a paginated result set. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the resolved `figma_accounts` is not `active` (and will update account status when the stored credential is expired/revoked).

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

resource_type.description: Filter to a single resource type.

status.description: Filter by local resource lifecycle status.

parent_resource_id.description: Filter resources whose `parent_resource_id` matches this local resource id.

figma_key.description: Filter by the remote Figma key (exact match).

team_id_key.description: Filter by Figma team id/key when present (exact match).

limit.description: Max number of records to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_resource
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single local `figma_resources` record by id. Returns the resource as stored (including `raw_metadata` when present). Refuses with NOT_FOUND when the id does not exist or does not belong to `account_id`, and with UNAUTHORIZED when the resolved account is not `active`.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

tool_schemas.name: figma_update_resource
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a local `figma_resources` record (e.g., name/description) and/or drives allowed lifecycle transitions on `status` (unknown↔active/archived, active↔archived, and active/archived→deleted). Returns the updated record. Refuses with CONFLICT for illegal status transitions, NOT_FOUND when the resource is missing, and UNAUTHORIZED when the resolved account is not `active`.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

name.description: Optional human-readable name override for the local catalog.

description.description: Optional description override for the local catalog.

status.description: Requested local lifecycle state. Must be a valid transition from the current state.

url.description: Optional canonical URL for the resource in Figma.

raw_metadata.description: Optional arbitrary metadata blob to store for the resource.

tool_schemas.name: figma_list_comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally stored `figma_comments` for a file, with optional filtering by status/resolved/creator. Returns a paginated result set. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when `file_resource_id` does not reference a `figma_resources` row of `resource_type='file'`, and UNAUTHORIZED when the resolved account is not `active`.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

file_resource_id.description: Local figma_resources id for the file whose comments are being listed (must be resource_type='file').

status.description: Filter by local comment lifecycle status.

created_by_figma_user_id.description: Filter to comments created by this Figma user id.

limit.description: Max number of records to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: figma_get_comment
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single local `figma_comments` record by id, including its lifecycle status and any `last_error`. Refuses with NOT_FOUND when missing or not owned by `account_id`, and UNAUTHORIZED when the resolved account is not `active`.

account_id.description: Local Figma account id to use for authentication.

tool_schemas.name: figma_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for this MCP server, including the resolved local Figma account (if any), its current scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption as observed by the server. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when no valid credential is available for the caller.

account_id.description: Optional local Figma account id. When provided, resolves and returns status/scopes for that account; when omitted, returns the default caller identity if configured.
